title: TNFR-Python-Engine: Resonant Fractal Nature Theory Implementation
description:
TNFR-Python-Engine is a Python framework for graph-coupled nodal dynamics and coherent-pattern research. The relation dEPI/dt = nu_f DeltaNFR connects form change, reorganization capacity and pressure. Pressure, phase, capacity, support, clock and forcing laws require explicit specifications.

Version 0.0.3.8 integrates an explicitly selected relational form-phase model with held capacity, shared SDK execution and detached reports. Conditional results address recovery, formation on supplied support, composition, transmission and reduced descriptions with memory. A proved example permits one passive bridge relocation between two prepared five-node rings while retaining their pattern recovery. Its open recovery region does not establish stability under arbitrary repeated switching.

Read-only attachment and relocation observers report changes in represented storage and rates, support cuts, transport reset and explicitly supplied work. They neither mutate live support nor select events. Numerical admission, JSON serialization, diagnostic availability and cache ownership are consolidated across the engine, CLI and SDK. Documentation is organized by theory, contracts and usage; optional arithmetic applications are separated under applications/.

Exact identities, conditional mathematical results, finite observations and auxiliary constructions retain distinct scopes. A support budget does not select an event or its clock; these remain the next research question. Physical identification, particles and autonomous substrate creation are not established.

See the 0.0.3.8 release, versioned source, Python package, theory catalog and current documentation.
